scope: Proposition 8.3 (Ordinary weight finiteness) of the manuscript “Fontaine–Mazur modularity at the prime 2” (preprints/Fontaine-Mazur-modularity-at-the-prime-2-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 010 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3c8797c7d468cdcc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 61. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The space W is an O-submodule stable under T1, the tame Hecke operators, and U±1, and these actions commute. Its dual M is finite over Ω. The closed commutative algebra generated by these actions on M is finite over Ω.
